The final race of the Tiara route, the 
Shuka Sho. Symboli Rudolf watches the 
clash of the century, while the Umamusume 
of the same generation burn with rivalry.

Meanwhile, Mejiro Ramonu quietly proceeded 
with her preparations, daydreaming about 
what color her reward would take once 
today came to an end.
